summary: Store the publisher’s records so each release can be inspected and compared. Keep unchanged records, save a new version when their contents change, and retain earlier versions for comparison. For a complete replacement release, records no longer supplied are marked as absent from that release.

en.description: Store the publisher’s records so each release can be inspected and compared. Keep unchanged records, save a new version when their contents change, and retain earlier versions for comparison. For a complete replacement release, records no longer supplied are marked as absent from that release.

zh-hant.description: 儲存發布者的記錄，讓每個版本都可供查閱及比較。未變更的記錄會保留原有版本；內容有變更時會儲存新版本，並保留舊版本供比較。對於完整替換的版本，不再提供的記錄會標記為不屬於該版本。

zh-hans.description: 存储发布者的记录，让每个版本都可供查阅及比较。未变更的记录会保留原有版本；内容有变更时会存储新版本，并保留旧版本供比较。对于完整替换的版本，不再提供的记录会标记为不属于该版本。
